keyFindings.description: Regression: GitHub Pages can be left at an older main commit's site. docs.yaml grouped main pushes as docs-refs/heads/main with cancel-in-progress false (main 184897ac docs.yaml:39-41), so docs builds ran in push order and a newer pending run replaced an older one. ci.yaml groups each main push by github.sha, so two docs-selecting merges build in parallel and their docs-deploy jobs enter the `pages` group in build-finish order: an older build that finishes later deploys over the newer site, or arrives while the newer deploy is pending and cancels it. docs-deploy is not in ci-ok's needs, so nothing turns red. Required: the site ends at the newest docs-selecting main commit's build, as before, proven on GitHub or by a stated mechanism.

Filter-drift check ignores a claimed go command's -tags and subcommand. The Run is pinned by substring and only its packages are compared; -tags is a VALUE_FLAG whose value is skipped, and Run.tags / Run.mode are never compared with the line. Reproduced in a scratch copy of ff92bbdf: probe file packages/envoy/cmd/broker/probe_test.go (//go:build probe, imports internal/routing) plus ci.yaml:2246 changed to `go test -tags multiprocess -count=1 -timeout 20m -v ./cmd/broker -tags multiprocess,probe` (go test honours the trailing -tags: verified, the probe file compiled) -> check-ci-filters.sh exit 0, 'broker-multiprocess: 279 files, 0 uncovered'. Control: the Run's tags set to multiprocess,probe -> exit 1 naming internal/routing/match.go and match_test.go uncovered. Same class the round-5 fix closed for packages; fix by deriving or comparing -tags (both spellings, last wins) and the subcommand (mode) from the claimed line and failing closed on a mismatch, with a test case.

The router guide tells a new job to set restore-keys to the family prefix unconditionally; ci.yaml (header lines 25-27, e.g. line 1161) sets it only off main, so the guide's recipe brings back the main prefix fallback this pull request removes. Docs-only; fix with the push.

ci: Required set on main (rulesets): lint, typecheck, test, pr-title; branch protection: none. Newest pull_request CI run 40674943570 at 6a43ed31 was still queued at 11:19Z (changes and pr-title queued); no CI run of any #2316 head has completed. A request for changes does not wait on it.
thermonuclear: deep review: CHANGES at ff92bbdf (Medium: Pages deploy order; Minor: go-daemon family shared by three jobs; Minor hardening: release builds restore CI-written Go caches). Code quality: CHANGES at ff92bbdf (tags/mode not compared, ci-ok needs unchecked, SELECTED_BY duplication, guide recipe drift, others cleanup). Adjudicated: the Pages order and the -tags hole stand; the guide recipe is fixed with the push; the rest are risk notes or the Fast-follow.
